## Specific strengths
- **note-229b7ccc884a380598a0** Scope-specific receipt sizing: The handoff keeps the existing receipt cap as the default and selects a larger bounded cap only for the selector-operation-permits scope. This isolates the larger batch requirement without broadening receipt size limits for unrelated handoff scopes. Evidence: [ev-21edf2c8a0ddcc477459449e](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/scripts/coverage_operator_handoff.py#L190), [ev-a8d47fc2203da206f1d4ce85](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/scripts/coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1).
- **note-9966c89b4dddcc917f05** Tests cover scope-specific boundaries: The added tests check a 39-operation receipt above the original limit, an over-cap selector batch, and an over-cap receipt for another scope. These cases statically exercise both the intended exception and preservation of the prior limit elsewhere. Evidence: [ev-1b3c55c14d4adb9677c38244](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1), [ev-53e8e2709cb8d87c2304dda6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1).
- **note-b59dc2921042f2a422e5** Tests cover the exception and its boundaries: The added test source covers an accepted 39-operation batch, rejection above the new cap, and retention of the original cap for another scope. These cases document both the intended special case and the bounds that prevent the exception from spreading. Evidence: [ev-1b3c55c14d4adb9677c38244](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1), [ev-53e8e2709cb8d87c2304dda6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1).
- **note-d30fee5e697db69366ca** Receipt size exception is narrowly scoped: The implementation selects a higher receipt limit only for the selector-operation-permits scope and retains the default cap for other scopes. This allows the larger batch receipt without broadly increasing the accepted receipt size for unrelated handoffs. Evidence: [ev-21edf2c8a0ddcc477459449e](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/scripts/coverage_operator_handoff.py#L190), [ev-dcbbe41009a3c17f6009197a](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/scripts/coverage_operator_handoff.py#L8).
- **note-ea0c9f56f4c07dd31e58** Tests boundary and scope-specific receipt limits: The added tests exercise a full 39-operation receipt above the ordinary cap, an oversized selector batch above the new cap, and an oversized receipt in a different scope. These cases assess both the intended exception and the preservation of the existing limit for other handoff scopes. Evidence: [ev-1b3c55c14d4adb9677c38244](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1), [ev-53e8e2709cb8d87c2304dda6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1).

## Future guidance
- **note-5a74817c3122a4d3e8f2** Keep the receipt-size contract aligned with the batch format: The test fixture verifies that its generated batch is no larger than the configured selector-batch cap. If the batch schema or operation schedule grows, consider updating the fixture and cap together so the size boundary remains explicit. Evidence: [ev-53e8e2709cb8d87c2304dda6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/9bb0b4edf9a07e5c558b8c9935f677d0fcba7ee3/tests/test_coverage_operator_handoff.py#L1).
